The function Dem_GetNumberOfFilteredDTC shall get the number of DTCs matching the filter criteria defined by the function call of Dem_Set- DTCFilter [SWS_Dem_00057].

Number of DTCs matching a DTC filter criteria If Dem_Get- NumberOfFilteredDTC is called, the Dem shall provide the number of DTCs match- ing the filter criteria defined by a DTC filter call within the out-parameter NumberOf- FilteredDTC .
